svg.text: Old beside new for each token that changes, then the new colours at work. A proposal: nothing in 08-kit is changed by it.
Red channel to zero: the mint cast goes, hue stays
Was RDM’s salmon (55% saturated); now red (69%)
9 to 10.5 px text was under 4.5:1 on a selected row
A dash is a reading; it should not need hunting for
The band gives way so the red can be a red
DERIVED, REGENERATED FROM THE NEW VALUES
Tags are the colour at 12% (fill) and 45% (edge) over bg1; the error line 16% and 50%.
Also kept: the amber tag fill and edge, the 19 job colours, the light theme’s live and crit.
MEASURED: WCAG CONTRAST, OLD THEN NEW
crit text on bg1, bg2, bg3
crit text on run band A, B
LIVE on its tag, IDLE on its tag
AT WORK: BEFORE ON THE LEFT, AFTER ON THE RIGHT
run bands at 26%; second row open (bg2)
Could not open: access is denied
run bands at 20%; second row open (bg2)
Could not open: access is denied
Pair, clock and tags; change text on the pane, a selected row and the run bands; hits
against the average; the cut-out at four strengths; the error line; labels and the faint ink.
WITHOUT RED AND GREEN: SIMULATED DEUTERANOPIA, PROTANOPIA
Good and bad now part by lightness as well as hue (0.10 of OKLCH lightness to a deuteranope,
up from 0.07). Green and amber stay close without colour; the tag’s word and mark carry it.
GREEN: NOW, PROPOSED, AND THE ALTERNATIVE
Signal green is the more vivid, but it lands 0.08 from THF and RNG and, to a deuteranope,
0.03 from the amber of HELD. Emerald keeps the distance; swatches: THF, RNG, SMN.
BESIDE THE JOB COLOURS: ROW SHADES AND THE CUT-OUT
The reds first. On a NIN, WAR or RDM row the fill sits 0.04 to 0.08 from the row’s own shade
with either red; the edge does the parting. Figures on it keep 9.6:1 at the strongest.
NEAREST NEIGHBOURS: 8 PX SWATCH, 6 PX BAR, AND THE DISTANCE
OKLab distance, old > new; under about 0.05 two marks of one shape read as one colour.
Runs and accent are kept: every hue is already a job’s, and a run always has its letter.
THE TRADE: HOW RED THE RED IS SETS HOW STRONG A RUN BAND CAN BE
Each column holds the red at 4.5:1 on its own bands: the redder the red, the darker it is,
so the paler the band must be. 20% still parts A from B (0.08) and from the pane (0.10).
crit #F26D78 is 55% saturated (HSV) at 70% lightness, and sits 0.034 from RDM #E86366:
it is, to the eye, the game’s own pink. WAR, NIN and SAM beside it run at 99 to 100%.
live #3DD68C carries 24% red (R 61 of 255), which greys it toward mint. THF’s green in
the same table is at chroma 0.234 against its 0.165.
Both sat inside what the screen can show: 84% and 90% of the chroma available at their
own hue and lightness. The new pair is at 100%, on the same hues, so nothing else moves.
What red gives up is luminance (Y 0.31 > 0.28): it still clears 5.0:1 on a selected row.
Run bands and cut-outs are drawn as in the kit: sRGB blend over bg1.
